blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion enables low-latency, streamable video generation, but prediction errors often accumulate over long rollouts. Training the generator on its own rollouts exposes it to these imperfect histories. However, existing video-level distribution matching distillation (DMD) scores the whole rollout jointly. Because a chunk is evaluated together with its past and future, its correction can favor matching artifacts in the surrounding context merely to preserve temporal consistency. To provide a clearer visual-quality signal, we introduce Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD). RMD retains the generated history for AR prediction but scores each chunk independently against a chunk teacher, ensuring its quality correction is not compromised by an imperfect temporal context. To compensate for the lack of temporal context in independent chunk scoring, RMD subsequently applies video-level DMD to restore temporal coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RMD maintains high visual quality far beyond its training horizon and outperforms video-level DMD baselines. Code and video results are available at https://cjeen.github.io/RMD/ .
blocks.zh: 自动递归(AR)视频的传播使得低纬度,流畅的视频生成成为可能,但预测错误经常在长时间的推广中积累. 对发电机进行自我推广培训使其暴露于这些不完善的历史。 然而,现有的视频级发行配比蒸馏(DMD)则联合评分整个推出. 由于一块块连同它的过去和未来一起被评估,它的校正可以有利于在周围背景下的文物匹配,仅仅是为了保持时间的一致性. 为了提供更清晰的视觉质量信号,我们引入了"滚出-火星蒸馏"(RMD). RMD为AR预测保留了生成的历史,但每个块对一个块的老师独立评分,确保其质量校正不会受到不完善的时间背景的影响. 为了弥补独立块评分中时间背景的缺失,RMD随后应用视频级DMD来恢复时间一致性. 广泛的实验表明,RMD的视觉质量远远超出其培训范围,并且超过了视频级的DMD基线。 代码和视频结果见https://cjeen.github.io/RMD/。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 2: Comparison of real-score predictions under video-level DMD and RMD. (a) The autoregressive rollout accumulates visual artifacts. (b) Video-level DMD scores the sequence jointly, causing the real-score prediction to retain these historical artifacts. (c) RMD scores the current chunk independently, providing a clean target regardless of the degraded context.
blocks.zh: 图2:视频级DMD和RMD下真实分数预测比较. (a) 自动推展可累积视觉文物。 (b) 视频级的DMD对序列进行联合评分,导致实数预测保留这些历史文物。 (c) RMD对当前块进行独立评分,不论退化背景如何,都提供一个干净的目标。

blocks.en: Due to high computational and memory costs, video diffusion models are typically trained on short clips ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026a ) . However, many real-world applications demand much longer sequences, including autonomous-driving simulation, interactive and embodied world models, and physics-grounded visual simulation ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . Autoregressive (AR) models naturally support this by extending video generation chunk by chunk ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026a ) . Specifically, the diffusion process for each new chunk conditions on previously generated frames. As the video grows, a sliding context window ensures the model only attends to the most recent history, keeping the generation cost bounded. However, this sequential process introduces an inherent challenge: each generated chunk inevitably contains minor prediction errors, which then become the context for future steps. Consequently, errors barely noticeable in a short sequence can compound and severely degrade visual quality over a long rollout.
blocks.zh: 由于计算成本和内存成本高,视频传播模型通常都接受短片的培训(Wan等人,2025年;Huang等人,2026a年)。 然而,许多现实世界的应用需要更长的序列,包括自主驾驶模拟,互动和内含的世界模型,以及物理基础的视觉模拟(张等人,2025年;布鲁斯等人,2024年;刘等人,2024年). 自动递减(AR)模型通过逐块扩展视频生成块自然支持这一点(Yin等人,2025年;Huang等人,2026a年)。 具体而言,在以前产生的框架上,每个新块条件的传播过程。 随着视频的增长,滑动的上下文窗口确保模型只关注最近的历史,保持生成成本的限制. 然而,这一顺序过程带来了固有的挑战:每个生成的块都不可避免地包含一些微小的预测错误,然后成为未来步骤的背景。 因此,短序列中几乎不明显的错误会在长时间的推出过程中使视觉质量复杂化和严重下降。

blocks.en: To mitigate error accumulation, self-rollout training exposes the generator to its own imperfect predictions ( Huang et al., 2026a ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Since a generated video rarely matches real videos perfectly, no paired ground-truth continuation exists to supervise the next steps. To overcome this lack of paired data, distribution matching distillation (DMD) is often employed ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2025 ) . Instead of requiring exact continuations, a bidirectional diffusion teacher evaluates the entire sequence jointly. It provides corrective feedback by matching a fake score tracking the student’s output against a real score representing the teacher’s high-quality prior.
blocks.zh: 为了减少误差的积累,自我推出训练使发电机暴露在自己的不完善预测中(Huang等人,2026a; 朱等人著, 2026 ). 由于生成的视频很少与真实的视频完全吻合,因此没有成对的地面真实续作来监督接下来的步骤. 为了克服这种缺乏配对数据的现象,往往采用配对的分布蒸馏法(Yin等人,2024年b); Yin et al., 2025 (英语). 与其要求精确的续作,不如由双向传播老师联合评价整个序列. 校对:Soup

blocks.en: However, DMD-trained models still struggle to generate very long sequences. We attribute this to a bias introduced by the video teacher’s joint supervision. As visual artifacts accumulate over a long autoregressive rollout (e.g., the severe texture and color corruption in the background foliage in Figure 2 (a)), the teacher must evaluate the new chunk alongside this flawed history. Because the teacher cannot modify past frames, enforcing a clean, natural background in the current chunk would cause an abrupt visual shift. Consequently, to preserve temporal consistency, the video-level teacher often retains these accumulated errors, which manifest as non-physical ghosting artifacts, in its real-score prediction (Figure 2 (b)). The temporal consistency constraint thus fundamentally limits the teacher’s ability to correct local errors.
blocks.zh: 然而,经过DMD训练的模型仍然难以生成非常长的序列. 我们将此归咎于视频老师的联合监督带来的偏见。 随着视觉文物在长时间的自递式推广过程中积累起来(例如图2(a)背景叶的严重纹理和颜色腐败),教师必须评估新的块与这一有缺陷的历史。 因为老师不能修改过去的帧,在当前的块中执行一个干净的自然背景会导致突然的视觉转变. 因此,为了保持时间一致性,视频级教师经常在真实的预测中保留这些累积错误,这些错误表现为非物理的幽灵文物(图2(b))。 因此,时间一致性制约从根本上限制了教师纠正当地错误的能力。

blocks.en: We break this coupling with Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD). The generator still uses its history to produce continuations, but the teacher evaluates the generated chunk independently, without checking the history or future chunks. As shown in Figure 2 (c), context-free scoring ensures the teacher provides a clean, high-fidelity real score despite the degraded history. RMD achieves this by matching the student’s chunk marginal distribution to a teacher-defined chunk distribution. To provide this supervision, we prepare the RMD teacher by adapting a video diffusion model on individual chunks extracted from videos generated by the original bidirectional model. However, because independent chunk supervision does not enforce cross-chunk relationships, generated videos might exhibit motion jitter between chunks. To resolve this, we subsequently refine the generator with a video-level DMD stage, explicitly smoothing these transitions to promote temporal coherence.
blocks.zh: 我们打破了这种与 " 推出 " (RMD)的结合。 生成器仍然利用其历史来制作续作,但老师独立评价生成的块,而不检查历史或未来的块. 如图2(c)所示,尽管历史已经退化,但无上下文评分确保了教师提供干净、高忠诚度的真正评分。 RMD 通过将学生的块边分布匹配到教师定义的块分布来实现此目标 。 为了提供这种监督,我们通过对从最初双向模型产生的视频中提取的单个块的视频传播模型进行改造,为RMD教师做准备. 然而,由于独立的块监督没有强制实施跨块关系,生成的视频可能在块之间显示出运动的焦躁。 为了解决这个问题,我们随后用视频级的DMD舞台改进了发电机,明确平滑这些过渡,以促进时间一致性.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that RMD achieves significantly higher visual quality than video-level DMD baselines beyond the training horizon. Our quantitative evaluation covers rollouts of approximately 60 seconds ( 12 × 12\times the 5-second training horizon). In addition, Figure 1 provides a qualitative example extending to 500 seconds ( 100 × 100\times the training horizon). Generation relies entirely on a fully sliding context window, without fixed anchors such as frame sinks ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , additional explicit memory mechanisms, or changes to the generator architecture.
blocks.zh: 广泛的实验表明,RMD的视觉质量大大高于超过训练视野的视频级DMD基线. 我们的定量评估包括大约60秒(12×12秒为5秒训练范围)。 此外,图1还提供了一个质量实例,可扩展至500秒(100×100\时为训练地平线). 生成完全依赖于一个完全滑动的上下文窗口,没有固定锚点,如帧槽(Yang等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年),额外的显式内存机制,或改变生成器架构.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Causal video diffusion generates frames or blocks sequentially with KV caching for
low-latency streaming. CausVid converts a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion model into a
causal generator and extends DMD to few-step video generation ( Yin et al., 2025 ) . Self-Forcing
further performs autoregressive rollout during training, feeding generated outputs back as context
and supervising the sequence with a holistic video objective ( Huang et al., 2026a ) .
Causal Forcing instead studies initialization and uses an autoregressive teacher for ODE
distillation before applying Self-Forcing DMD ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Causal-rCM similarly combines
teacher-forced consistency training with self-forced DMD refinement ( Zheng et al., 2026a ) .
Solaris introduces Checkpointed Self Forcing , which decouples serial self-rollout from parallel
differentiable replay to reduce training memory ( Savva et al., 2026 ) . Together, these methods
establish causal students and on-policy training pipelines. We adopt the Solaris replay
mechanism directly and focus RMD on the distribution matched during on-policy DMD.

blocks.en:
DMD trains a few-step generator by minimizing a reverse KL divergence to the distribution of a
pretrained diffusion model, using the difference between real and fake scores as generator
supervision ( Yin et al., 2024b ) . DMD2 removes the costly regression objective and improves stability
through a two-time-scale update rule, adversarial learning, and multi-step training ( Yin et al., 2024a ) .
Subsequent work has combined distribution matching with adversarial learning ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , replaced KL-based
matching with an optimal-transport objective ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , or coupled reverse-KL refinement
with score-regularized consistency training ( Zheng et al., 2026b ) . These developments primarily
modify the divergence, regularization, or optimization of distribution matching. By contrast, RMD
retains the DMD score-difference update but changes its output space from a joint rollout to the
chunk marginal induced by autoregressive sampling.

blocks.en:
LongLive improves extended AR generation through streaming long-video tuning, a finite attention
window, and a persistent frame sink ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Rolling Sink studies cache
maintenance beyond the training horizon and introduces a training-free cache-maintenance
strategy ( Li et al., 2026 ) . More directly related to training-time supervision, OPSD-V
post-trains few-step AR generators on their inference-time trajectories while supplying the teacher
with a cleaner cache that can incorporate real long-video context ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Most closely related to our
analysis, Context-Matched Distillation (CMD) observes that a bidirectional full-clip teacher can use
future information unavailable to a causal student ( Bandyopadhyay et al., 2026 ) . CMD addresses
this issue with a causal teacher and prefix scoring under the student’s realized rollout context.
RMD takes a different route. It does not construct a teacher conditional for each self-rollout
history. Instead, it uses a bidirectional diffusion prior as a chunk-distribution target, scores the
rollout chunks independently, and subsequently restores joint temporal structure through video-level
refinement. It therefore requires neither paired continuations for generated histories nor real
long-video context.

blocks.en: 3 Rollout-Marginal Distillation
blocks.zh: 3 推出-最小蒸馏

blocks.en: In this section, we present Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD), an approach designed to disentangle visual quality supervision from temporal context in autoregressive video generation. We first review video-level distribution matching distillation (DMD) and formalize how its joint scoring mechanism inherently couples the current chunk’s gradient to past and future frames (Section 3.1 ). To break this coupling, we introduce our rollout-marginal objective, which independently penalizes unrealistic chunks without conditioning on the imperfect context (Section 3.2 ). We then detail the training procedure in practice (Section 3.3 ). Finally, because independent scoring ignores cross-chunk relationships, we describe a subsequent video-level refinement stage that explicitly restores temporal coherence (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍 " 推出海洋消化 " (RMD),这是一种在自动视频生成中将视觉质量监督从时间背景中分离出来的方法。 我们首先审查视频发行量匹配蒸馏(DMD), 为了打破这种结合,我们提出我们推出的边际目标,它独立地惩罚不切实际的块块,而不以不完美的背景为条件(第3.2节)。 然后,我们详细说明实际的培训程序(第3.3节)。 最后,由于独立评分忽略了跨圆形的关系,我们描述了随后一个视频级的完善阶段,明确恢复了时间一致性(第3.4节).

blocks.en: 3.1 Revisiting Video-Level Distribution Matching
blocks.zh: 3.1 重审视频级配送

blocks.en: To understand the necessity of rollout-marginal supervision, we first examine how video-level DMD improves a causal video generator and why its joint scoring mechanism introduces a critical flaw.
blocks.zh: 为了了解推出-边际监管的必要性,我们首先研究视频级DMD如何改进一个因果视频生成器,以及为什么其联合评分机制引入了关键缺陷.

blocks.en: Given a text prompt c c , let the causal generator G θ G_{\theta} produce a latent rollout 𝐱 = ( x 1 , … , x T ) \mathbf{x}=(x_{1},\ldots,x_{T}) , where each x i x_{i} is a chunk. The distribution of the generated video 𝐱 \mathbf{x} can be naturally factorized as: q θ ​ ( 𝐱 ∣ c ) = ∏ i = 1 T q θ ​ ( x i ∣ x < i , c ) . q_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}\mid c)=\prod_{i=1}^{T}q_{\theta}(x_{i}\mid x_{<i},c). (1) Following the self-rollout framework ( Huang et al., 2026a ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) , the generator conditions each continuation on its own generated history x < i x_{<i} , exposing it to the prediction errors it will encounter at inference. Because there are no ground-truth continuations paired with these imperfect generated histories, video-level distribution matching distillation (DMD) is employed to supervise the entire student rollout jointly ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2025 ) .

At noise level τ \tau , let 𝐱 τ = α τ ​ 𝐱 + σ τ ​ ϵ \mathbf{x}_{\tau}=\alpha_{\tau}\mathbf{x}+\sigma_{\tau}\bm{\epsilon} denote a noised rollout. The video-level objective minimizes the reverse KL divergence between the noised student video distribution q θ , τ q_{\theta,\tau} and a pretrained teacher video distribution p τ p_{\tau} : ℒ video ( θ ) = 𝔼 c , τ [ D KL ( q θ , τ ∥ p τ ) ] . \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{video}}(\theta)=\mathbb{E}_{c,\tau}\!\Bigl[D_{\mathrm{KL}}\!\bigl(q_{\theta,\tau}\,\|\,p_{\tau}\bigr)\Bigr]. (2)

The generator is updated using the difference between two diffusion scores: ∇ θ ℒ video ≈ 𝔼 ⁡ [ w ⁡ ( τ ) ​ J θ ​ ( 𝐱 ) ⊤ ​ ( s fake ​ ( 𝐱 τ , τ , c ) − s real ​ ( 𝐱 τ , τ , c ) ) ] , \nabla_{\theta}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{video}}\approx\mathbb{E}\!\Bigl[w(\tau)J_{\theta}(\mathbf{x})^{\top}\bigl(s_{\mathrm{fake}}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau},\tau,c)-s_{\mathrm{real}}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau},\tau,c)\bigr)\Bigr], (3) where J θ ​ ( 𝐱 ) = ∂ 𝐱 / ∂ θ J_{\theta}(\mathbf{x})=\partial\mathbf{x}/\partial\theta is the generator Jacobian, w ⁡ ( τ ) w(\tau) is a noise-level weight, s real s_{\mathrm{real}} is a frozen teacher score representing the target distribution, and s fake s_{\mathrm{fake}} is an online score model trained to track the student’s distribution.

Equation 3 reveals a fundamental issue in applying video-level DMD to autoregressive rollouts. Both the real and fake score networks ( s real s_{\mathrm{real}} and s fake s_{\mathrm{fake}} ) take the entire sequence 𝐱 τ \mathbf{x}_{\tau} as input. Consequently, the correction signal assigned to any specific chunk x i x_{i} is coupled with its generated past ( x < i x_{<i} ) and future ( x > i x_{>i} ). If an artifact appears in the generated history, a joint score evaluation will likely penalize a sudden correction to natural colors in the current chunk, as such a transition breaks the temporal consistency of the sequence. The model is thereby forced to compromise local visual realism to accommodate an imperfect temporal context. To resolve this, we must disentangle the quality supervision of x i x_{i} from the rest of the rollout.
blocks.zh: 方程式3揭示了将视频级DMD应用到自旋式推出中的一个基本问题. 真实和假的得分网(s real s_{\mathrm{ real}} 和s假 s_{\mathrm{假}}) 将整个序列 x\\ mathbf{xXX}_{\tau} 作为输入。 因此,分配给任何特定块x i x_{i}的校正信号与其生成的过去(x < i x_{<i})和未来(x > i x_{>i})结合。 如果一件文物出现在生成的历史中,联合得分评价可能会惩罚对当前块中自然颜色的突然修正,因为这样的过渡会打破序列的时间一致性. 该模型因此被迫损害当地视觉现实主义,以适应不完善的时间背景. 为了解决这个问题,我们必须将xi xx_{i}的质量监督与推出的其余部分分开。

blocks.en: 3.2 Rollout-Marginal Objective
blocks.zh: 3.2 推出-边际目标

blocks.en: Video-level DMD scores the entire sequence, tying each chunk’s quality correction to its compatibility with the surrounding content. RMD breaks this dependency by matching chunks from the causal rollouts independently, while the generator still uses its history for prediction.
blocks.zh: 视频一级 将每个块的质量校正与周围内容的兼容性联系起来。 RMD通过独立匹配因果推出的块来打破这种依赖性,而生成器仍然使用它的历史来预测.

blocks.en: We model the initial and continuation chunks separately to account for their distinct latent statistics. Specifically, under the video VAE, the first latent frame encodes only the initial image without temporal compression ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026a ) . This gives it completely different statistical properties compared to subsequent frames. Let q θ , 1 ​ ( x 1 ∣ c ) q_{\theta,1}(x_{1}\mid c) denote the initial chunk distribution. To define the continuation rollout marginal , we pool the chunks x 2 , … , x T x_{2},\ldots,x_{T} across the student’s causal rollouts for prompt c c : q θ , chunk ( T ) ​ ( x ∣ c ) = 1 T − 1 ​ ∑ i = 2 T 𝔼 x < i ∼ q θ ​ ( x < i ∣ c ) ​ [ q θ ​ ( x ∣ x < i , c ) ] . q^{(T)}_{\theta,\mathrm{chunk}}(x\mid c)=\frac{1}{T-1}\sum_{i=2}^{T}\mathbb{E}_{x_{<i}\sim q_{\theta}(x_{<i}\mid c)}\!\left[q_{\theta}(x\mid x_{<i},c)\right]. blocks.en: Crucially, the generation process remains causal, meaning each sample x i x_{i} is still produced conditionally from its actual on-policy history x < i x_{<i} . However, the supervision applied to each chunk is entirely context-free. This objective simply penalizes generated chunks that are unlikely under the teacher’s chunk distribution. By doing so, it explicitly isolates visual quality supervision from the imperfect generated history. Instead of forcing the model to repeat past artifacts to maintain temporal consistency, this marginal matching ensures the teacher guides the current chunk toward high-quality targets, regardless of the flaws in the preceding frames.
blocks.zh: 关键的是,生成过程仍然是因果性的,意味着每个样本xi x_{i}仍然从其实际政策史x < i x_{<i}中有条件地生成. 然而,对每个块实施的监督是完全无上下文的。 这个目标只是惩罚在教师块分配下不太可能产生的块。 通过这样做,它明确地将视觉质量监督与产生的不完善历史隔离开来. 这种边际匹配不但没有迫使模型重复过去的文物以保持时间的一致性,反而确保了老师引导当前块向高质量的目标前进,而不管前面的框的缺陷如何.

Adapted score networks evaluate them independently without temporal context. The resulting gradients ( g 1 , … , g T g_{1},\dots,g_{T} ) are backpropagated via differentiable causal replay.

blocks.en: 3.3 Rollout-Marginal Training
blocks.zh: 3.3 推出-边际培训

blocks.en: To realize this decoupled supervision in practice, our training pipeline (Figure 3 ) optimizes the rollout-marginal objective by first generating the causal rollout, then evaluating the initial and continuation chunks against their distinct target distributions, and finally backpropagating the isolated gradients to the generator.
blocks.zh: 为了在实践中实现这种脱钩的监管,我们的培训管道(图3)优化了推出边际目标,首先产生因果推出,然后根据它们独特的目标分布来评价初始和延续块,最后将孤立的梯度反向传播到发电机上.

blocks.en: We initialize the AR generators from Causal Forcing’s causal ODE checkpoints ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Following the self-forcing framework ( Huang et al., 2026a ) , at each training iteration, we generate a causal rollout of chunks x 1 , … , x T x_{1},\ldots,x_{T} , sampling each chunk in 4 denoising steps. To retain the temporal dynamics prior in the pretrained model, we carefully choose which denoising step to supervise for each chunk ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . Early steps in the sampling trajectory rely heavily on historical context to establish global motion, and applying independent supervision at these timesteps would disrupt the temporal consistency. Therefore, we adopt an asymmetric supervision strategy: for the initial chunk x 1 x_{1} , we compute the loss at a randomly selected intermediate exit step along the trajectory, whereas for the continuation chunks x 2 , … , x T x_{2},\ldots,x_{T} , we apply the loss only at the final, lowest-noise step of the rollout where the network refines local visual details.
blocks.zh: 我们从Causal Forcing因果的ODE检查站(Zhu等人,2026年)启动AR发电机。 遵循自强制框架(Huang et al., 2026a),在每次训练迭代时,我们生成一个块×1,..., x T×××1},\ldots,x××T},在4个去诺步骤中对每个块进行取样。 为了在预先训练的模型中保持时间动态,我们仔细选择对每个块进行监督的去诺步骤(Wu等人,2026年)。 取样轨迹的早期步骤在很大程度上依赖于历史背景来确定全球运动,在这些时间步上实施独立监督会破坏时间一致性. 因此,我们采取一种不对称的监督策略:对于最初的块××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××

blocks.en: To score the sampled chunks, we use separate teacher targets for the initial frame and continuations. As discussed in Section 3.2 , Wan’s causal VAE gives them different latent statistics. An unmodified video teacher would treat an isolated continuation chunk as the start of a video and expect an uncompressed first frame. We therefore adapt the Wan 14B video teacher ( Wan et al., 2025 ) with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) on continuation chunks extracted from videos generated by the original model. The adapted teacher supplies the continuation target p chunk , τ p_{\mathrm{chunk},\tau} in Equation 5 , allowing each continuation to be scored without its generated history.
blocks.zh: 为了给样本分数,我们使用单独的老师目标来进行初始帧和续集. 正如第3.2节所讨论的,Wan的因果关系提供了不同的潜在统计数据。 一个没有修改的视频老师会把一个孤立的续集块当作视频的开始,并期望有一个没有压缩的第一帧. 因此,我们将Wan 14B视频教师(Wan et al.,2025年)与LORA(Hu et al.,2022年)调整为从原模型产生的视频中提取的续集块。 校对:Soup

blocks.en: For each x i x_{i} , we add scoring noise and obtain clean predictions from its teacher and fake-score networks on the same noisy input. Let D real , i D_{\mathrm{real},i} and D fake , i D_{\mathrm{fake},i} denote these two predictions. Their normalized difference gives a gradient estimate g i g_{i} for the chunk: g i = D fake , i − D real , i mean ⁡ | x i − D real , i | . g_{i}=\frac{D_{\mathrm{fake},i}-D_{\mathrm{real},i}}{\operatorname{mean}|x_{i}-D_{\mathrm{real},i}|}. (6) To propagate g i g_{i} to the generator parameters, we follow checkpointed self-forcing ( Savva et al., 2026 ) . The causal rollout is generated without retaining its computation graph. A differentiable replay then recomputes each supervised prediction from its sampled noisy input and generated history, allowing g i g_{i} to be backpropagated through the generator.
blocks.zh: 对于每个xi xx_{i},我们加入评分噪声,从它的老师和假分网络获得同样的响亮输入的干净预测. 让D真实, i _{\ mathrm{ real}, i} 和 D 假, i _{\ mathrm{ fake}, i} 表示这两个预测 。 它们的常态差给块的梯度估计 g i g_{i} : G I = D 假的,I = D 真实的,I = D 真实的,I = D 真实的,I = 真实的。 g_{i}=\frac{D_{\ mathrm{假},i}-D_{\ mathrm{真},i}}{\operatorname{mean}|x_{i}-D_{\ mathrm{真},i}|}. (6) 将g i g_{i} 推广到生成器参数中, 在不保留其计算图的情况下生成因果滚动。 一个不同的重播,然后重新计算每个被监督的预测 从其抽样的噪音输入和生成历史, 允许g i g_{i}通过生成器反射。

blocks.en: The first latent frame has different statistics from later latents. Once it leaves the sliding window, the generator must predict without that distinctive frame, a condition absent from short training rollouts that can cause flicker. Following Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2026a ) , we mask attention to the initial block when replaying predictions in the latter half of the training window.
blocks.zh: 第一个潜在框架有与后来潜在不同的统计。 一旦离开滑动窗口,发电机就必须在没有这种独特框架的情况下作出预测,而这种条件在短期的训练推广中是不存在的,这会造成闪烁。 继"自强"(Huang et al., 2026a)之后,我们在训练窗口后半段重播预测时掩盖了对初始块的注意.

blocks.en: 3.4 Refinement with Video-Level DMD
blocks.zh: 3.4 完善视频级DMD

blocks.en: Matching chunk marginals improves their appearance but does not directly constrain the transitions between them. Individually realistic chunks can still form a video with inconsistent appearance or motion. We therefore refine the AR generator with the video-level DMD objective in Equation 2 .
blocks.zh: 匹配块边缘可以改善它们的外观,但不会直接限制它们之间的过渡. 个人现实的块仍然可以组成一个外观或运动不一致的视频. 因此,我们用2号方程式的视频级DMD目标改进AR生成器。

blocks.en: The generator still produces causal self-rollouts, but the video teacher and online fake-score network now evaluate each complete rollout jointly. Their score difference updates the generator through the same differentiable replay, supervising motion and consistency across chunks. This stage begins from a generator already trained using the rollout-marginal objective. We use smaller learning rates to limit the changes made during refinement.
blocks.zh: 生成器仍然产生因果自滚,但视频老师和在线假分网现在联合评价每一次完全推出. 他们的分数差异通过相同的不同重播,监督运动和跨块的一致性来更新生成器. 这个阶段是从一个已经通过推出边际目标培训的发电机开始的。 我们使用较小的学习率来限制在改进过程中所作的改变。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We distill the pretrained Wan 14B video diffusion model into a causal Wan 1.3B generator, initialized from Causal Forcing’s causal ODE checkpoints ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . RMD is trained in two stages using a metadata set comprising 70,000 unique prompts sourced from Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2026a ) . Our models are trained under a strictly fixed 81-frame horizon, without performing longer rollouts during the training phase.
blocks.zh: 我们把预先训练的Wan 14B视频传播模型提炼成一个因果Wan 1.3B生成器,由Causal Forcing的因果ODE检查站(Zhu等人,2026年)初始化。 RMD使用一套元数据进行分两个阶段的培训,该元数据集由来自Self Forcing(Huang等人,2026a)的70 000个独特的提示组成。 我们的模型是在严格固定的81个范围范围内进行训练的,在训练阶段没有进行较长的推广。

blocks.en: All trainable networks are optimized using AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) ( β 1 = 0 \beta_{1}=0 , β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{2}=0.999 , weight decay 0.01 0.01 ) with a global batch size of 8. During the rollout-marginal training stage, we alternate 5 fake-score updates for every 1 generator update. When the chunk size is 1, both the generator and fake-score networks use a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , and we train for 900 steps. When the chunk size is 3, the generator learning rate remains 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , while the fake-score learning rates are reduced to 2 × 10 − 7 2\times 10^{-7} , and we train for 750 steps. In the subsequent video-level refinement stage, the generator and fake-score learning rates are reduced to 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} and 4 × 10 − 7 4\times 10^{-7} , respectively, and both models are trained for 800 steps.
blocks.zh: 所有可训练网络均采用AdamW(Lohchilov和Hutter,2019年)(β 1 = 0\β1}=0,β 2 = 0.999\β2}=0.9999,重量衰减0.01 0.01)优化,全球批量规模为8. 在推出-边际训练阶段,我们轮流为每1个发电机更新5个假分数更新. 当块大小是1时, 发电机和假分数网络 使用2×10−5 2\times 10×5}的学习率, 我们训练900步。 当块大小是3时, 发电机的学习率保持在2×10−5 2\times 10×5}, 而假分的学习率 则减少到2×10−7 2\times 10×7, 我们训练750步。 在之后的视频一级精细化阶段,发电机和假分的学习率分别降低到2×10−6 2\times 10×6}和4×10−7 4\times 10×7],两个型号都经过800步的训练.

blocks.en: We adopt the VBench-Long suite ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026b ) for our primary evaluation, using the complete standard set of 944 unique prompts with five generations per prompt. All videos are generated at 832 × 480 832\times 480 resolution and 16 FPS, and evaluated at a duration of approximately 60 seconds for both chunk sizes. The 500-second rollout in Figure 1 is a qualitative example and is not included in these aggregate metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们采用V Bench-Long套房(Huang等人,2024年;Huang等人,2026年b)进行初步评估,采用完整的标准套套套944个独特的提示,每提示5代。 所有视频都是以832×480 832\times 480分辨率和16 FPS生成的,并用大约60秒的时间对两个块大小进行评价. 图1中的500秒推出是一个定性实例,没有列入这些汇总指标。

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 与基线的比较

blocks.en:
Figure 4: Qualitative comparison of long-horizon generation. While baseline
methods suffer from severe color saturation and structural collapse beyond their training
horizon, RMD consistently preserves sharp subject details and stable scene structures.

blocks.en: We compare RMD with Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2026a ) and Causal Forcing ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Both baselines share our standard sliding-window generation protocol, operating entirely without fixed frame anchors or modifications to the underlying autoregressive logic. This isolates the distillation objectives and ensures RMD introduces zero additional computational overhead during inference. We report results separately using chunk sizes of 1 and 3.
blocks.zh: 我们比较RMD与Self Forcing(Huang等人,2026a)和Causal Forcing(Zhu等人,2026). 两个基线都共享我们的标准滑窗生成协议,操作时完全没有固定框架锚或修改基本的自递性逻辑. 这隔离了蒸馏目标,并确保RMD在推论中引入零额外计算间接费用. 我们使用1号和3号块分别报告结果。

blocks.en: Figure 4 presents corresponding qualitative comparisons over extended rollouts. Within the 5-second training horizon, all methods generate reasonable frames. However, as generation progresses far beyond this boundary (20s, 40s, 60s), the baselines exhibit visual degradation including color saturation and structural collapse. In contrast, RMD consistently preserves clear subject details and stable scene structures throughout the 1-minute trajectory.
blocks.zh: 图4提供了与扩展版相应的质量比较。 在5秒训练范围内,所有方法都会产生合理的框架. 然而,随着生成过程远远超越这个边界(20,40,60),基线显示出视觉退化,包括色饱和和和结构崩溃. 相比之下,RMD在整个1分钟的轨迹中始终保留清晰的主题细节和稳定的场景结构.

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the quantitative comparison on 1-minute generated videos. RMD establishes a clear advantage across both configurations. With a chunk size of 1, our method improves the total score by over 10 absolute points compared with the baselines (81.26 vs. 70.94 and 69.88), while attaining quality and semantic scores of 84.52 and 68.24, respectively. With a chunk size of 3, RMD achieves a total score of 81.48, with corresponding quality and semantic scores of 85.03 and 67.24. Together, these quantitative and qualitative results demonstrate that explicitly decoupling chunk supervision from historical context effectively prevents the degradation typical of joint video-level distillation.
blocks.zh: 表1对1分钟制作的视频进行了定量比较。 RMD在两种配置之间建立了明显的优势. 宽度为1,我们的方法比基线(81.26对70.94和69.88)提高了10个以上的绝对分数,同时质量和语义分数分别为84.52和68.24。 块大小为3,RMD总得分81.48分,相应的质量和语义分数分别为85.03分和67.24分. 这些定量和定性的结果表明,明确将块监督与历史背景脱钩,有效地防止了视频联合蒸馏的典型退化。

blocks.en: 4.3 Long-Horizon Extrapolation
blocks.zh: 4.3 长视距外推法

blocks.en: To assess performance degradation over extended rollouts, we evaluate the same videos generated with a chunk size of 1 at durations ranging from 10 to 60 seconds. Figure 5 plots the performance dynamics over these trajectories. RMD maintains stable visual quality as the rollout extends: its quality score changes only from 84.68 at 10 seconds to 84.52 at 60 seconds, where it retains a semantic score of 68.24. In contrast, the baselines degrade steeply as prediction errors compound; for example, the total score of Self Forcing drops from 79.12 to 70.94 over the same interval. This robust extrapolation confirms that independent chunk supervision effectively mitigates the accumulation of visual artifacts.
blocks.zh: 为了评估在扩展推出过程中的性能退化,我们评价了同样的视频,在持续时间从10秒到60秒之间,其大小为1块。 图5列出了这些轨道上的性能动态。 RMD随着推出的扩展而保持稳定的视觉质量:其质量分数仅从84.68分10秒变化到84.52分60秒,其中保留了68.24的语义分数. 相比之下,基线作为预测错误复合物急剧降解;例如,Self Forcing的总得分在同一间隔期间从79.12下降到70.94。 这种强有力的推论证实,独立的块监督有效地减轻了视觉文物的积累.

完整的RMD既实现了高视觉质量,也实现了时间一致性.

blocks.en: Table 2 evaluates the components of RMD using a chunk size of 1. Applying video-level DMD alone yields a total score of 72.44, and qualitatively, the generation rapidly collapses into severe color artifacts (Figure 6 ). Optimizing exclusively for the rollout-marginal objective ( Marginal only ) raises the quality score to 84.90, confirming that context-free scoring effectively prevents the visual degradation.
blocks.zh: 表2用1块大小来评价RMD的组件. 光是应用视频级的DMD,总得分就达到72.44分,在质量上,这一代迅速崩溃成严重的彩色文物(图6 )。 完全优化推出-边际目标(仅边缘)将质量分数提高到84.90,证实无上下文评分有效防止视觉退化.

blocks.en: While the Marginal only variant achieves high visual realism, it lacks cross-chunk constraints and falls short on temporal coherence, which is visibly manifested as jagged flickering in its spatio-temporal slice (Figure 6 ). The full RMD pipeline resolves this via subsequent refinement with video-level DMD, which improves subject consistency, background consistency, and motion smoothness (Table 2 (b)). As shown in Figure 6 , this combined approach achieves the best total and semantic scores (81.26 and 68.24, respectively) while restoring smoother, more continuous trajectories in the spatio-temporal slice.
blocks.zh: 虽然边际只变体能实现高视觉现实主义,但它缺乏跨圆形的制约,而且没有达到时间一致性,这明显地表现为其时空切片(图6)的夹痕闪烁。 整个RMD管道通过随后用视频级的DMD进行改进解决了这个问题,这提高了主题的一致性,背景的一致性,以及运动的光滑性(表2(b))。 如图6所示,这一综合方法在斯皮提奥-时段切片中实现了最优的总分和语义分数(分别为81.26分和68.24分),同时恢复更平滑,更连续的轨迹.

blocks.en: A variant that applies random-step exits uniformly across all chunks suffers from severe temporal jitter (Figure 6 ) and performs worse across all metrics, with total and quality scores of 78.29 and 82.48, respectively (Table 2 (a)). This supports our asymmetric design: supervising the initial chunk across random steps preserves the pretrained temporal prior, while restricting continuation chunks to the final exit strictly refines local details.
blocks.zh: 在所有小块上统一适用随机步骤退出的变体会到严重的时间紧张(图6),在所有指标上表现更差,总分和质量分数分别为78.29和82.48(表2(a))。 这支持了我们的不对称设计:通过随机步骤对初始块进行监管,保留了预先训练的时间前段,同时将续集块限制在最后出口时严格地细化了本地细节.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Autoregressive video generation inherently suffers from error accumulation because joint temporal scoring forces the teacher to compromise local visual quality for sequence-level consistency. To resolve this coupling, we introduce Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD), which disentangles spatial realism from temporal coherence. By independently matching chunk marginals and subsequently refining global dynamics, RMD provides a clean, context-free supervision signal. Quantitative evaluations over 60-second rollouts demonstrate that RMD effectively prevents artifact accumulation beyond the training horizon, while a 500-second qualitative example illustrates its potential at substantially longer durations. We believe this decoupled paradigm offers a robust foundation for future long-horizon, streamable video generation.
blocks.zh: 自动回转的视频生成在本质上受到错误堆积的影响,因为联合时间评分迫使老师为了序列级的一致性而损害局部视觉质量. 为了解决这种耦合问题,我们引入了 " 推出 " 海洋蒸馏 " (RMD),它将空间现实主义与时间一致性脱钩。 RMD通过独立匹配块边并随后完善全球动态,提供干净,无上下文的监督信号. 在60秒的推广中进行的定量评价表明,研究与监测方案有效防止了超过培训阶段的文物积累,而500秒的定性实例表明,它在较长的时间内的潜力。 我们认为,这种脱钩的范式为未来长期、可流传的视频制作提供了坚实的基础。
